story: “It was Jonas’ dream to be on the Tour de France podium,” said Van der Poel after an impressive duo attack with Alpecin–Deceuninck teammate Rickaert in what became the second-fastest Tour stage ever. The effort earned Rickaert the combativity award. Van der Poel lost a thrilling cat-and-mouse game to the peloton in the final kilometers, that saw Merlier sprint to his second stage win in 2025.
